description: Use this when the user names a drink they like and wants something similar, a lighter or lower-alcohol option, or both, for example "I like Moscow Mules. Suggest something similar, and a lighter option too." or "What is a low-alcohol drink like an Espresso Martini?". Suggests cocktails similar to that one from the Garçon catalogue, with each drink's strength, flavours and fixmeadrinkapp.com page, plus low or zero-proof options that share its flavours or base spirit; set low_proof to true to get only low and zero-proof alternatives. Drinks are for adults of legal drinking age.

low_proof.description: True to suggest only low and zero-proof drinks
